outline.description: Lists the definitions a file declares, each with its line range and the line IDs that edit it. The first look at an unfamiliar file.

inspect.description: Search a file's structure with a Tree-sitter query or a named template, and answer with each match's line range and the ids that edit it.

view.description: Print a file's lines with the ids that edit them, or with only_ids the ids and line numbers alone.

edit.description: Apply edits transactionally to a file. Answers with the lines it changed, each as [id, line number], so a following edit needs no second read.

create.description: Write a new file and answer with its lines, each as [id, line number] when asked. Refuses to overwrite a file that exists, so an existing file is changed with edit.
